title: EXPERIMENTAL: FIVE MORE SWITCHES (PILLAGER ROLES, SUPPRESSION, MACHINES VS PILLAGERS, ELITE AFFIXES, OVERSEER PHASES)
why: The experimental page gets its next five switches, all on by default. Off, a pillager has no role, rounds past him pin nobody, machines and pillagers do not pick each other as foes (a Bulwark or plain Warden stops hunting pillagers), an elite machine is a plain elite and the Overseer is one long health bar with a cannon. A switch is read when the raid starts. The open row also moves from the head of ACCESSIBILITY to the end of THE RAID, next to the rows it affects.
now: The experimental page switches pillager roles, suppression, machines vs pillagers, elite affixes and the overseer phases.
